data.name: NoLid
data.value: This computer has no lid. These settings apply if it is used on one that does.

data.name: HelpText
data.value: When the Lid Is Closed sets what closing the lid does: on battery, plugged in, and with another monitor or a dock connected. Lock the screen locks and turns the screen off but stays awake; if the computer cannot hibernate, it is locked instead. With another monitor, the laptop's own screen turns off and its windows move to the other monitors, whatever is chosen. Lock the screen before sleeping locks the session before every suspend, so it never wakes unlocked. Changes apply at once; Reset restores the settings from when this window opened.

data.name: HintWithMonitor
data.value: What closing the lid does with another monitor or a dock; the laptop's screen turns off either way

data.name: HintLockBeforeSleep
data.value: Lock the session before every suspend, so it never wakes unlocked
